summary: Implemented header alignment, shared panel rounding, tighter tool-call row pitch, a per-turn reply footer with run time and copy button, a generated thread-name feature wired from a new Settings option through protocol/server/client, and protocol support for marking assistant message completion. Verified end-to-end against a real thread at localhost:5173; all 553 tests, svelte-check, prettier, and file-length checks pass.
decisions: Thread header height uses the shared --header-row-h token so thread header and inspector header align at y 48–114.
Conversation panel and its header take --radius-sm top corners to match the folder-tab shelf.
Tool-call/reasoning row pitch tightened from 44px to 38px by setting the per-grouped-message margin to 2px (--space-2), since a multi-step reply produces many grouped messages rather than one.
Reply footer shows 'Worked for X' plus a copy button on each finished assistant reply; the THREAD eyebrow was removed and the title ellipsizes instead of pushing actions off the row.
Streaming/total run time now counts from the start of the turn rather than the last assistant message, so it no longer restarts on every tool call.

Generated thread names: new 'Thread name model' setting (default Off) in Settings → Chat; a thread is named from its first message once the first reply lands, threads the user renames are left alone, and failures silently keep the existing name.

Added an optional completedAt on assistant messages (client-stamped when a run goes idle, derived from the newest entry timestamp of the turn when loading persisted transcripts); older transcripts show no footer rather than a wrong number.
errors: Dev server could not bind port 8787 because an orphan agent-server from a previous start (PID 24944) was holding the port, causing the app to show 'Could not connect'; resolved by killing that process and starting a fresh server.
Prettier reported 6 files with style issues; fixed by running --write, after which --check passed.
